eventMetadata.context_description: No. 1 seed Arizona Wildcats (35-2) enter the West Region Elite Eight final as the consensus trader favorite against No. 2 Purdue Boilermakers (30-8) at San Jose's SAP Center, driven by their dominant 35-2 regular season and decisive Sweet 16 rout of Arkansas. Purdue advanced past Texas despite guard C.J. Cox's hyperextended knee in that game—he's cleared and starting alongside Smith, Loyer, Kaufman-Renn, and Cluff. The pivotal frontcourt battle pits Purdue's physical bigs (Kaufman-Renn, Cluff) against Arizona's Peat and Krivas, with foul trouble a key risk in this neutral-site clash. No other major injuries reported, emphasizing continuity, recent tournament momentum, and second-half execution as outcome shapers.
